standard.summary: 噪声强度。relative 时为相对 RMS 倍率
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The noise strength. Under relative it is a multiplier on the RMS
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 噪声强度。relative 时为相对 RMS 倍率；absolute 时为绝对标准差。常用 0.01~0.017（默认 0.0125）。

advanced_en.principle: Noise strength. In relative mode it is a multiplier on RMS; in absolute mode an absolute standard deviation. Common range 0.01~0.017 (default 0.0125).
